chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl, from Zurārah, who said:
I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a man who forgets the takbīrat al-iḥrām. He said: He repeats.

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam addressed in this narration
key_terms.تَكْبِيرَةَ: the declaration of takbīr; here the opening formula beginning the prayer
key_terms.يَنْسَى: forgets; refers here to omission out of forgetfulness
key_terms.يُعِيدُ: he repeats; meaning he must perform the prayer again
key_terms.ٱلْإِحْرَامِ: the consecrating commencement of salat (prayer), by which prohibited acts become forbidden within prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets takbīrat al-iḥrām in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who forgets the opening takbīrah of salat (prayer). Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that the prayer must be repeated, showing the essential status of takbīrat al-iḥrām in the validity of the prayer.
